title: Conan O'Brien Voices a Potty-Training Toy in Toy Story 5 — and an Intern Designed Him!
summary: Imagine a toy that helps you learn to use the potty — but it sounds like it had one too many sodas! That's Smarty Pants, a new character in Toy Story 5. He's a potty-training toy voiced by Conan O'Brien, and he's already making audiences laugh out loud. When Jessie, the cowgirl, meets Smarty Pants in an old playhouse, his batteries are so low that he slurs his words like a sleepy grown-up. Conan's voice makes him sound hilariously chaotic. Smarty Pants was left behind by a girl named Blaze, who got newer tech toys. Now he just stares longingly at the bathroom, because his whole world is about toilet time. The best part? A Pixar intern named Naomi drew the very first sketch of Smarty Pants! The designers tried drawing pants and toilet lids, but nothing worked until Naomi's idea. They made him look like a retro toy with an LCD screen and three buttons, so he feels like a hand-me-down. We've only seen the first half of the movie, but the filmmakers say Smarty Pants has an even bigger role later. With Conan's voice and that goofy design, he might just steal the whole show.
why_it_matters: This story shows that even a simple drawing from a new intern can become a big part of a world-famous movie—your own ideas might one day make people smile, too.

keywords.explanation: Slurs means speaking in a slow, unclear way, like when someone is very tired or has a low battery.
An intern is a person who works at a company for a short time to learn new skills, often while still in school.
Retro means something that looks like it came from the past, often with an old-fashioned style.
An LCD screen is a thin, flat display that shows images or words, like on a simple calculator or old toy.
A hand-me-down is an item that belonged to someone else first and was given to you to use again.
Chaotic means completely wild and out of control in a funny or messy way.

background_read: The Toy Story movies are a famous series from Pixar Animation Studios, the company that also made Finding Nemo and Inside Out.
Conan O'Brien (a funny talk show host and comedian) has been on TV for many years, making people laugh with his wild style.
Many real toys, like Mr. Potato Head and Slinky Dog, became even more popular after appearing in earlier Toy Story films.
Article_Structure: WHO: Smarty Pants, a new potty-training toy voiced by Conan O'Brien, and Pixar intern Naomi who designed him.
WHAT: Smarty Pants, a low-battery, retro toy with an LCD screen, has a hilarious voice and an even bigger role in Toy Story 5.
WHERE: In an old playhouse where Jessie meets Smarty Pants, and inside the world of Toy Story.
WHY: To add a fresh, chaotic character created from an intern's clever idea, making audiences laugh.

perspectives.description: Fans think Smarty Pants is the funniest new toy in the movie, and his slurred voice makes every scene feel fresh and silly.
Some people worry that a potty-training toy with a low-battery joke might get old fast and not be as lovable as classic characters like Woody.
The story behind the toy shows that Pixar likes to take risks and lets people from all levels, even interns, contribute surprising ideas.
